---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| cache: true
mallards <- read_csv("data/mallards.csv") |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = ymd_hms(timestamp),
    month = month(timestamp, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    month_num = month(timestamp),
    year = year(timestamp),
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month_num %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "Autumn",
      TRUE ~ "Winter"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter"))
  )

saveRDS(mallards, "data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
mallards_mapped <- mallards |>
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(long)) |>
  arrange(timestamp)

countries <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = countries,
    fill = "#f4f1e8",
    color = "#a3a3a3",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = mallards_mapped,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = duck_id, color = duck_id),
    linewidth = 0.22,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = mallards_mapped,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id),
    size = 0.16,
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo", guide = "none") +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(7.5, 24),
    ylim = c(47, 54.5),
    expand = FALSE,
    datum = NA
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard GPS Movement",
    subtitle = "Paths and GPS fixes for 52 individually tracked mallards",
    caption = "Source: Mallard tracking data"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 8)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray40", hjust = 1),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eaf4f7", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
  )
```
